title: AARO says Go Fast is possibly parallax

tellings.quote: Arrow just came to the all domain anomalous resolution office. We just, you know, we're talking about its director. Uh came out and they said that this is possibly parallax.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, discusses Go Fast, a 2015 Navy video filmed off Jacksonville, Florida, that seems to show a small object racing low over the ocean. He says AARO, the Pentagon office set up to investigate unexplained objects, has said the speed is possibly parallax, an illusion where the camera's own movement makes a slow object look fast. That would mean the object may not be as remarkable as it appears.
